rule: Complete simulator coverage does not mean complete product implementation.

limitations: Evidence classification uses keyword-pattern matching over synthetic finding text; it does not perform semantic, statistical or scientific interpretation of evidence content.

Only the three canonical synthetic scenario evidence sets and purpose-built synthetic perturbation fixtures have been exercised; real-world evidence formats, languages, instruments or domains are not covered.
Minimum-evidence and conflict/insufficiency thresholds are illustrative synthetic parameters, not validated scientific, regulatory or commercial thresholds.
Does not integrate with any real data source, institution, country deployment or production system.

entries.classificationReason: An evidence-driven discovery evaluator is implemented and registered into CAP-34's live-simulation dispatcher. It computes its outcome from the eligibility state and finding content of the evidence it is given -- not from which scenario was selected -- and this data-sensitivity is proven in both directions by a dedicated perturbation test separate from the three canonical scenario checks.

limitations: Contradiction detection groups evidence by a keyword-derived subject key and compares stance only within that group; it does not perform semantic, statistical or scientific reasoning about the evidence's substance.

Only the three canonical synthetic scenario evidence sets and purpose-built synthetic perturbation fixtures have been exercised; real-world evidence formats, languages or domains are not covered.

entries.lastVerifiedAgainst: CAP-05 live-logic perturbation behavioural proof (10/10 fixtures): 3 canonical scenarios plus pairwise same-subject contradiction detection, named-category gap identification, and bidirectional sensitivity, plus dispatcher-wiring check.
entries.classificationReason: A pairwise-comparison reasoning evaluator is implemented and registered into CAP-34's live-simulation dispatcher. It detects contradiction only between evidence sharing a derived subject with opposing stances (not a per-record tally), and names the specific missing required category on knowledge gaps rather than reporting a bare count. This is proven by a dedicated perturbation test separate from the three canonical scenario checks.
nonImplications: Manifest inclusion does not establish product implementation, scientific proof, production readiness or commissioning.
Keyword-based subject grouping and stance comparison does not constitute genuine scientific, medical or regulatory reasoning and must not be presented as such.
